'''Sith dueling boots''' were a type of [[Boot/Legends|boot]] used by individuals affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The boots were sometimes used by members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Description==
A type of moderately [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Boot/Legends|boot]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] dueling boots could be worn on the feet of [[Species/Legends|species]] with similar foot structure to a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] to be used as protection during combat. The boots were mostly [[Color/Legends|red]] in color with silver-colored metal on the shins, the outer part of each foot and on the knees. Each of the metal pieces on the knees had a hollow red circle on them.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
Sith dueling boots were used by individuals affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> an [[Empire's Wrath|acolyte]] training to be a [[Sith Warrior]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] received a pair of Sith dueling boots after helping [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Cormun (Imperial Army)|Cormun]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Mission to Ajunta Pall's tomb (k'lor'slug extermination)|deal]] with an infestation of [[Worm/Legends|worm]]-like [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]] in the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sith dueling boots first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. The boots were the reward for members of the [[Sith Warrior]] class who completed the mission "K'lor'slug Infestation" which was one of the first quests available to starting Sith Warriors and [[Sith Inquisitor]]s on the planet Korriban. The quest could be completed by either the Inquisitor class or the Sith Warrior class, but only Sith Warriors received the Sith dueling boots.<ref name="TOR" /> The boots could also be crafted by Imperial characters with the Synthweaving crew skill using [[terenthium]] and [[rubat]] crystals.<ref name="Synthweaving">{{TORcite|Synthweaving}}</ref> The Sith dueling boots received by the Sith Warrior on Korriban were valued at 15 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="TOR" /> but the crafted boots' value varied upon the success of the crafting attempt.<ref name="Synthweaving" />
